skill.name: Spaced Repetition
skill.description: Scheduling review of material at expanding intervals to optimize long-term retention.
skill.summary: Retrieval, not re-exposure, is the active ingredient; spaced rereading barely beats massed. First review within 24h where decay is steepest; expanding intervals beat equal. FSRS optimizes to a target retention and beats SM-2 after ~1k reviews; 0.9 default, 0.97 costs ~2x reviews. One atomic fact per card; leeches at 8 lapses mean rewrite or suspend. 10-20 new/day sustainable; daily beats binge.
